Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-payments.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Budget range validation / token volumes — follow-up from today's call

Thanks again for taking time this morning — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and the asks we agreed to: 

- What we heard: Acme is evaluating Redwood for an AI assistant across payments support flows (customer inquiries, chargeback triage, routing).
- Info needed to size commercial options: expected monthly token volumes (pilot vs. production), target $/1M tokens you expect to budget for, and any internal procurement/PO thresholds we should be aware of.

Next steps we proposed on the call: 
1) You share a monthly usage band (pilot and expected steady-state).
2) We run a cost model with three scenarios (hosted pay-as-you-go, committed Dedicated discount tiers, and a hybrid burst model).
3) Draft a SOW/quote if the budget aligns.

I attached the latest Redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.pdf — it shows list and committed tiers so you have a frame of reference. To help accelerate, can you confirm the following by EOD?
- Pilot volume (tokens/month)
- Expected steady-state volume (tokens/month)
- Target $/1M tokens (ballpark range you need to hit)
- Procurement thresholds (PO limits, any approval gates)

If easier, a one-line reply with numbers is perfect.
Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick follow-up tomorrow if that helps.
Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.pdf (pricing matrix, 2 pages)

From: John Miller <john.miller@acme-payments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-payments.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation / token volumes — follow-up from today's call

Hey Marissa — thanks for the summary and the matrix, that helps. Quick answers from our side (high level):
- Pilot (1-2 months): ~2-3M tokens/month (mostly NLU + short responses)
- Production steady-state (Q3 target): ~8-12M tokens/month (peak spikes to ~18M in promo windows)
- Target blended price: we're looking to be around $900–$1,200 per 1M tokens for production (the team picked a target budget of roughly $8k–$12k/month at steady-state).
Procurement/approval constraints: 
- Team can do up to $10k/month on a credit card/standard SSO purchase.
- Anything above $10k/month goes through procurement for PO — procurement signs off up to $25k with standard terms.
- >$25k requires legal + procurement escalation and sometimes a 6-8 week SLA/contract timeline.
If you can provide a short quote (hosted vs. committed Dedicated) showing estimated monthly costs against the volumes above, that would help us decide whether to pursue a committed capacity deal.
Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the numbers.
John
Head of Product, Acme Payments
john.miller@acme-payments.com

That means if the steady-state quote sits above $15k, we'll need to loop in procurement now to avoid delays.
Actionable next step for us: please send a formal quote + short SOW for the 3 scenarios (hosted PAYG, 3-month pilot commit, 12-month Dedicated commit) with clear monthly cost and PO language. If the 12-month estimate looks like ~10M tokens at $1k/1M = $10k/month, that's within our low-touch band. If it lands closer to $1.2k/1M -> ~$12k/month — still OK for PO flow. If anything goes above $15k we will need procurement involvement.
We can target an internal procurement review next week if you get the docs over by EOD.
Thanks — we'll plan for the 10am PT sync tomorrow pending your doc.
John
